mapper.select: SELECT pc.*, w.SUBJECT AS workspace_name, old_md.NAME AS old_pm_name, new_md.NAME AS new_pm_name FROM PM_CHANGE pc JOIN WORKSPACES w ON pc.WORKSPACE_ID = w.WORKSPACE_ID JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS old_md ON pc.OLD_MEMBER_ID = old_md.MEMBER_ID JOIN MEMBER_DETAILS new_md ON pc.NEW_MEMBER_ID = new_md.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY pc.REQUESTED DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PM_CHANGE SET STATUS = #{status}, PROCESSED = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = #{reject_reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADMIN_ID = #{admin_id} WHERE PM_CHANGE_ID = #{pm_change_id} AND STATUS = 0
mapper.select: SELECT PM_CHANGE_ID, WORKSPACE_ID, OLD_MEMBER_ID, NEW_MEMBER_ID, REASON, STATUS FROM PM_CHANGE WHERE PM_CHANGE_ID = #{pm_change_id}

SELECT pm.PROJECT_ID FROM PROJECT_MEMBERS pm JOIN WORKSPACE_MEMBERS wm ON pm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID = wm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID WHERE wm.WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND wm.MEMBER_ID = #{new_member_id} AND wm.ROLE = 50 AND wm.STATUS = 0 AND pm.ROLE = 50 AND pm.STATUS = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE PROJECT_MEMBERS SET ROLE = 50 WHERE WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID IN ( SELECT WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID FROM WORKSPACE_MEMBERS WHERE WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND MEMBER_ID = #{old_member_id} AND STATUS = 0 ) AND PROJECT_ID IN ( SELECT pm.PROJECT_ID FROM PROJECT_MEMBERS pm JOIN WORKSPACE_MEMBERS wm ON pm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID = wm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID WHERE wm.WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND wm.MEMBER_ID = #{new_member_id} AND wm.ROLE = 50 AND wm.STATUS = 0 AND pm.ROLE = 50 AND pm.STATUS = 0 ) AND ROLE = 70 AND STATUS = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROJECT_MEMBERS (PROJECT_MEMBER_ID, PROJECT_ID, WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID, ROLE, STATUS, JOINED) SELECT seq_project_members.NEXTVAL, p.PROJECT_ID, wm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID, 70, 0, SYSDATE FROM PROJECTS p JOIN WORKSPACE_MEMBERS wm ON p.WORKSPACE_ID = wm.WORKSPACE_ID WHERE p.WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND wm.MEMBER_ID = #{new_member_id} AND wm.STATUS = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID AND pm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID = wm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID )
mapper.update: UPDATE PROJECT_MEMBERS SET STATUS = 1, LEFT = SYSDATE WHERE WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID IN ( SELECT WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID FROM WORKSPACE_MEMBERS WHERE WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND MEMBER_ID = #{old_member_id} ) AND ROLE = 70 AND STATUS = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT_MEMBERS pm JOIN PROJECTS p ON pm.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID JOIN WORKSPACE_MEMBERS wm ON pm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID = wm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID WHERE p.WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND wm.MEMBER_ID = #{new_member_id} AND pm.ROLE = 70 AND pm.STATUS = 0
mapper.update:

AND wm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID = pm.WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ID AND p.WORKSPACE_ID = #{workspace_id} AND wm.MEMBER_ID = #{new_member_id} AND wm.STATUS = 0 )
